title: File:Kharkiv after shelling on 18 March 2022 (01).jpg
desc: Kharkiv after shelling on 18 March 2022 during Russian invasion of Ukraine. Emergency service of Ukraine reports ruining of a 6-storey building of a higher educational institution and damage of 2 neighboring apartment buildings. One person was killed, 11 injured and one more remains under rubble.
